data.content_ref: inline:Kind: Abstraction. The isolated node represents an abstract instance of the 'Error Elimination Principle' which SRC_003 instantiates concretely in the domain of epistemology. The biological analogy in SRC_003 is merely one concrete manifestation of this higher-order abstraction.
